scripts.build: npm run build -w @steward/module-sdk && npm run build -w @steward/module-host && npm run build -w @steward/contracts && npm run build -w @steward/platform && npm run build -w @steward/ui && npm run build -w @steward/master-api && npm run build -w @steward/worker-api && npm run build -w @steward/master-web && npm run build -w @steward/worker-web && npm run build -w @steward/installer

scripts.build:operations: cd modules/operations && npm ci && npm run build
